verses.original: Οἱ κύριοι τὸ δίκαιον καὶ τὴν ἰσότητα τοῖς δούλοις παρέχεσθε εἰδότες ὅτι καὶ ὑμεῖς ἔχετε Κύριον ἐν οὐρανῷ
verses.transliteration: Hoi kyrioi to dikaion kai tēn isotēta tois doulois parechesthe eidotes hoti kai hymeis echete Kyrion en ouranō
verses.literal: Masters supply your slaves with what is right and fair since you know that you also have a Master in heaven

verses.original: Τῇ προσευχῇ προσκαρτερεῖτε γρηγοροῦντες ἐν αὐτῇ ἐν εὐχαριστίᾳ
verses.transliteration: Tē proseuchē proskartereite grēgorountes en autē en eucharistia
verses.literal: Devote yourselves to prayer being watchful and thankful

verses.original: προσευχόμενοι ἅμα καὶ περὶ ἡμῶν ἵνα ὁ Θεὸς ἀνοίξῃ ἡμῖν θύραν τοῦ λόγου λαλῆσαι τὸ μυστήριον τοῦ Χριστοῦ δι’ ὃ καὶ δέδεμαι
verses.transliteration: proseuchomenoi hama kai peri hēmōn hina ho Theos anoixē hēmin thyran tou logou lalēsai to mystērion tou Christou di’ ho kai dedemai
verses.literal: as you pray also for us that God may open to us a door for the word so that we may proclaim the mystery of Christ for which I am in chains

verses.original: ἵνα φανερώσω αὐτὸ ὡς δεῖ με λαλῆσαι
verses.transliteration: hina phanerōsō auto hōs dei me lalēsai
verses.literal: Pray that I may declare it clearly . . . as I should . . .

verses.original: Ἐν σοφίᾳ περιπατεῖτε πρὸς τοὺς ἔξω τὸν καιρὸν ἐξαγοραζόμενοι
verses.transliteration: En sophia peripateite pros tous exō ton kairon exagorazomenoi
verses.literal: Act wisely toward outsiders redeeming the time

verses.original: ὁ λόγος ὑμῶν πάντοτε ἐν χάριτι ἅλατι ἠρτυμένος εἰδέναι πῶς δεῖ ὑμᾶς ἑνὶ ἑκάστῳ ἀποκρίνεσθαι
verses.transliteration: ho logos hymōn pantote en chariti halati ērtymenos eidenai pōs dei hymas heni hekastō apokrinesthai
verses.literal: Let your speech always be . . . gracious seasoned with salt so that you may know how to answer everyone . . .

verses.original: Τὰ κατ’ ἐμὲ πάντα γνωρίσει ὑμῖν Τυχικὸς ὁ ἀγαπητὸς ἀδελφὸς καὶ πιστὸς διάκονος καὶ σύνδουλος ἐν Κυρίῳ
verses.transliteration: Ta kat’ eme panta gnōrisei hymin Tychikos ho agapētos adelphos kai pistos diakonos kai syndoulos en Kyriō
verses.literal: Tychicus will tell you all the news about me He is a beloved brother a faithful minister and a fellow servant in the Lord

verses.original: ὃν ἔπεμψα πρὸς ὑμᾶς εἰς αὐτὸ τοῦτο ἵνα γνῶτε τὰ περὶ ἡμῶν καὶ παρακαλέσῃ τὰς καρδίας ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: hon epempsa pros hymas eis auto touto hina gnōte ta peri hēmōn kai parakalesē tas kardias hymōn
verses.literal: I have sent him to you for this very purpose that you may know about us and that he may encourage your hearts

verses.original: σὺν Ὀνησίμῳ τῷ πιστῷ καὶ ἀγαπητῷ ἀδελφῷ ὅς ἐστιν ἐξ ὑμῶν πάντα ὑμῖν γνωρίσουσιν τὰ ὧδε
verses.transliteration: syn Onēsimō tō pistō kai agapētō adelphō hos estin ex hymōn panta hymin gnōrisousin ta hōde
verses.literal: With him I am sending Onesimus our faithful and beloved brother who is one of you They will tell you about everything here

verses.original: Ἀσπάζεται ὑμᾶς Ἀρίσταρχος ὁ συναιχμάλωτός μου καὶ Μᾶρκος ὁ ἀνεψιὸς Βαρνάβα περὶ οὗ ἐλάβετε ἐντολάς ἐὰν ἔλθῃ πρὸς ὑμᾶς δέξασθε αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Aspazetai hymas Aristarchos ho synaichmalōtos mou kai Markos ho anepsios Barnaba peri hou elabete entolas ean elthē pros hymas dexasthe auton
verses.literal: My fellow prisoner Aristarchus sends you greetings . . . as does Mark the cousin of Barnabas You have already received instructions about him If he comes to you welcome him

verses.original: καὶ Ἰησοῦς ὁ λεγόμενος Ἰοῦστος οἱ ὄντες ἐκ περιτομῆς οὗτοι μόνοι συνεργοὶ εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Θεοῦ οἵτινες ἐγενήθησάν μοι παρηγορία
verses.transliteration: kai Iēsous ho legomenos Ioustos hoi ontes ek peritomēs houtoi monoi synergoi eis tēn basileian tou Theou hoitines egenēthēsan moi parēgoria
verses.literal: Jesus who is called Justus also sends greetings These are the only Jews among my fellow workers for the kingdom of God and they have been a comfort to me

verses.original: Ἀσπάζεται ὑμᾶς Ἐπαφρᾶς ὁ ἐξ ὑμῶν δοῦλος Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ πάντοτε ἀγωνιζόμενος ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν ἐν ταῖς προσευχαῖς ἵνα σταθῆτε τέλειοι καὶ πεπληροφορημένοι ἐν παντὶ θελήματι τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Aspazetai hymas Epaphras ho ex hymōn doulos Christou Iēsou pantote agōnizomenos hyper hymōn en tais proseuchais hina stathēte teleioi kai peplērophorēmenoi en panti thelēmati tou Theou
verses.literal: Epaphras who is one of you and a servant of Christ Jesus sends you greetings . . . He is always wrestling in prayer for you so that you may stand mature and fully assured in the full will of God

verses.original: μαρτυρῶ γὰρ αὐτῷ ὅτι ἔχει πολὺν πόνον ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν καὶ τῶν ἐν Λαοδικείᾳ καὶ τῶν ἐν Ἱερα‿ πόλει
verses.transliteration: martyrō gar autō hoti echei polyn ponon hyper hymōn kai tōn en Laodikeia kai tōn en Hiera polei
verses.literal: For I testify about him that he goes to great pains for you and for those at Laodicea and - Hierapolis . . .

verses.original: Ἀσπάζεται ὑμᾶς Λουκᾶς ὁ ἰατρὸς ὁ ἀγαπητὸς καὶ Δημᾶς
verses.transliteration: Aspazetai hymas Loukas ho iatros ho agapētos kai Dēmas
verses.literal: Luke the beloved physician and Demas send you greetings . . .

verses.original: Ἀσπάσασθε τοὺς ἐν Λαοδικείᾳ ἀδελφοὺς καὶ Νύμφαν καὶ τὴν κατ’ οἶκον αὐτῆς ἐκκλησίαν
verses.transliteration: Aspasasthe tous en Laodikeia adelphous kai Nymphan kai tēn kat’ oikon autēs ekklēsian
verses.literal: Greet the brothers in Laodicea as well as Nympha and the church that meets at her house

verses.original: Καὶ ὅταν ἀναγνωσθῇ παρ’ ὑμῖν ἡ ἐπιστολή ποιήσατε ἵνα καὶ ἐν τῇ Λαοδικέων ἐκκλησίᾳ ἀναγνωσθῇ καὶ τὴν ἐκ Λαοδικείας ἵνα καὶ ὑμεῖς ἀναγνῶτε
verses.transliteration: Kai hotan anagnōsthē par’ hymin hē epistolē poiēsate hina kai en tē Laodikeōn ekklēsia anagnōsthē kai tēn ek Laodikeias hina kai hymeis anagnōte
verses.literal: After this letter has been read among you make sure that it is also read . . . in the church of the Laodiceans and that you in turn read the letter from Laodicea

verses.original: Καὶ εἴπατε Ἀρχίππῳ Βλέπε τὴν διακονίαν ἣν παρέλαβες ἐν Κυρίῳ ἵνα αὐτὴν πληροῖς
verses.transliteration: Kai eipate Archippō Blepe tēn diakonian hēn parelabes en Kyriō hina autēn plērois
verses.literal: Tell Archippus See to it that you complete the ministry you have received in the Lord

verses.original: Ὁ ἀσπασμὸς τῇ ἐμῇ χειρὶ Παύλου Μνημονεύετέ μου τῶν δεσμῶν Ἡ χάρις μεθ’ ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: Ho aspasmos tē emē cheiri Paulou Mnēmoneuete mou tōn desmōn Hē charis meth’ hymōn
verses.literal: This greeting is in my own hand Paul Remember my chains Grace be with you
